notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks 1.0 Launches on Steam
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that [b]our publisher Wired Productions and developer Caged Element have officially launched Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks on Steam today.[/b] Following an early access phase that saw over 250,000 players blast opponents, this high-octane combat racing game has had some tuning up and has sped into 1.0. 

Last week, Wired Productions revealed they had taken over publishing rights – [b]removing microtransactions entirely [/b]- and introducing fresh tracks, maps, game modes, and customization options. Assemble your crew of Grotz, Gitz, and Squigz – and battle in PVP and PVE lobbies! 

Visit the Warhammer site for more details and stay tuned for insights into the game's next explosive chapter, as Wired Productions continues its partnership with Caged Element, the original publisher of 2018’s acclaimed GRIP: Combat Racing. Embrace the chaos, ignite the battles, and experience the thrill of Speed Freeks like never before.

Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks is available now on Steam at a special discounted price of just $15.99, €15.99 and £12.79.  

[b]New content includes:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Player-hosted games: Create private or public lobbies with custom settings.  
[*] New Vehicle – Trukk: A havoc-wreaking ambush vehicle with a fearsome amount of firepower and rowdy orks in the back.  
[*] New Game Mode - Free Roam: Choose any map and create custom races around it, as well as practice driving skills and abilities.  
[*] New Maps: Da Dust Up and Da Gorge are Speed Freeks’ most dynamic and visually striking to date.  
[*] Ork Pit Bosses: Players can now unlock and customize Ork avatars to show off to teammates and enemies alike.  
[*] Alternative Weapons: Unlockable weapons expand the playstyles of each vehicle for new ways to master them.  
[/list]

notes.title: The Hotel Architect Demo is now live!
notes.content:
The wait is over! Our demo is now available as part of Steam Next Fest. This is your chance to step into the shoes of a hotelier and design the ultimate guest experience. Whether you've been eagerly following the game's development or are just discovering it, the demo offers a hands-on preview of what it takes to build, manage, and customize a world-class hotel.  

For those new here: What is Hotel Architect & What should you expect in the Demo?  

Hotel Architect is a detailed hotel management simulation that allows you to craft unique and luxurious accommodations (or not... Your choice!). Juggle the increasingly elaborate demands of disorderly guests, logistical nightmares and unexpected obstacles in the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game.  

In this demo, you can explore two stunning destinations: the bustling city of Gothenburg and the sun-soaked shores of Santorini. Each location presents unique challenges and opportunities, encouraging you to think strategically as you design and manage your properties.  

[b]Key features of the demo include: [/b] 

[list] 

[*] Scenario and Sandbox Modes - Tackle structured objectives or unleash your creativity in open-ended play.  
[*] Customizable Hotel Designs - Design every aspect of your hotel, from room layouts to décor  
[*] Diverse Guest Types - Cater to different guest profiles, each with unique needs and expectations. 
[*] Operational Challenges - Manage staffing, amenities, and services to keep guests happy and your business thriving.  

[/list] 

[b]FAQ [/b] 

We also have a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1602000/discussions/0/596267508946698487/]frequently asked questions[/url] post in the discussion area on steam so you can get help if needed. This will be a work in progress, but please check there before posting as it’ll help manage the flow of questions incoming during the demo!

notes.title: Vostok Inc. activates other languages
notes.content:
Hey, Vostokians!

Long time no speak, but we thought we would drop you an update on some languages we have turned on for anyone buying 'Vostok Inc.'

Tweeter user 进击的苦力怕 dropped us a message.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29467002/11fe6854c98eb53bc19312cbe8a835d9afd5f495.jpg[/img]

This got us scratching our heads and wondering why he wouldn't have access to this already. After a lot of troubleshooting and some guidance from 进击的苦力怕. We got to the bottom of it.

This means that the game now has Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese languages accessible from whichever Steam store you have bought it from. We have put a simple guide together on how you access these.

• Right-click the game in the Steam list, and select "Properties". Then use the "Language" drop-down box to select one of the recently included languages. The game will need a small update (~500KB) when the language is changed with this option. (English also covers French, German, and Spanish)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29467002/df9582d118114aefff8ebe51f829f08312b52907.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29467002/093b1863748f659962f1ccd777a439e655504d16.png[/img]

• If you have already generated a save file with another language, you will need to go to the in-game Language setting to change the language again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29467002/5f8dec0671bf24fe86033a90ba849781a60889f4.png[/img]

• The "Simplified Chinese" option includes both Simplified and Traditional Chinese!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29467002/2c87c8e20f2be385977eaff4888fa4b3a994ac17.png[/img]

notes.title: NEW PATCH - 1.02 "Zip it Jimmy!" Now live.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29467002/34d0d1a470759be49357f4ed19b726fbbdb644be.png[/img]
  
 [*]Fixed a bug where buying multiple buildings at once would not tally correctly which meant Liquid processor and atmosphere plant didn’t unlock correctly.
   [*]Fixed a bug where buying multiple buildings at once would not tally correctly meaning cross building bonuses weren’t correct.
   [*]Fixed Objectives 525, 526 and 527 not unlocking.
   [*]Fixed currency out of range bug that would break the game when the player had a high enough income.
   [*]Fixed a bug where the unlock criteria for unlocking Casinos was referencing the wrong weapon.
   [*]Fixed a turret in Vent not damaging player.
   [*]Fixed a bug where some objectives that had been completed weren’t showing correctly.
   [*]It’s possible to shut Jimmy up, from the settings menu.
   [*]Jimmy’s call frequency dialed down from every 30 seconds to every 90 seconds.
   [*]Added the ability to adjust the volume of voices individually.
   [*]Added more lines for Jimmy so he doesn’t repeat himself as often (Limited to English).
   [*]Added effect to manager indicator to make it more obvious when they spawn.
   [*]Now when the the player flies over a dead exec they are removed from the radar.
   [*]Halved executive consumption, meaning they take twice the time to consume items.
   [*]Added a cool video glitch effect to changing solar system in the galactic map.
   [*]After level 20 enemies do incrementally more damage to the player.
   [*]Marauder (miniboss) enemy increased loot drop
   [*]Tweaked the time between groupings of enemies so things are a little less hectic.
   [*]Late game economy smoothed out. Buildings after the School are now cheaper to buy or give greater returns.
   [*]The targeting computer toggle state is now saved into the player profile.
   [*]Arrow keys used to scroll stats and tutorial log (set as right stick).
   [*]Various other small tweaks and fixes.

Keyboard rebinding is done (pending localisation and testing) and will be patched as soon as it's tested and localised.
